messages:
alex: Heads-up: nightly perf runs show KV slab fragmentation + unbounded mem growth on long chat contexts (50k tokens) on H100 staging. Seen after kernel-selector change earlier today.
carol: on it. can you paste the perf-bot link and the job id? also which model config?
alex: perf-bot posted: https://ci.internal/runs/5782 diff commit abc123->def456. Model: redwood/gptx-13b, kv_page_size=64KB, slab_coalesce=auto
perf-bot: nightly-run 5782: mem_growth=+2.3GB per 10k tokens (h100-rtx mix), regression detected vs baseline 5775 :thumbsup:
michael: thought slab coalesce tweak was safe. suspect page-table remap path hit on H100 due to segstride differences. batching heuristic also changed windowing which may change reuse patterns
sarah: can repro locally on h100-1 with minimal harness. command:
```
./perf/harness --model gptx-13b --tokens 50000 --batch-size 1 --kv-page-size 65536 --log-kv
```
alex: repro logs: `kv_pager: evict_count spikes when reuse_gap ~512` and `pt_remap: stale_owner detected` multiple times
carol: here's short dump snippet (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-12 03:21:10] kvcache: slab_free_list len=0
[2026-03-12 03:21:10] pager: allocating new page id=0x7f8c
[2026-03-12 03:21:10] pt: remap owner=GPU0 -> owner=GPU1 (race?)
```
michael: hypothesis: kernel-selector now prefers fused attention kernel on H100 which uses different stride layout, causing page splitting in slab allocator -> fragmentation + wrong eviction ordering. RT vs A100 differ because kernel emits different tile shapes
sarah: quick mitigation: revert fused kernel for h100 or force slab_coalesce=always for H100. either could be canary in dedicated. which is least invasive?
alex: revert kernel selector for H100 seems fast. but we should add regression test: long-context mem growth with mixed kernels + batch windowing
carol: I'll open an RFC and a short PR: disable fused-attn on h100 by default, and add hermetic microtest. tagging @michael @sarah
michael: also add telemetry: `kvcache.fragmentation_ratio` and `pt.remap_race_count` to console; will help postmortem
sarah: doing quick repro now, will paste flamegraphs and nvprof outputs
alex: thanks. let's keep thread for updates. if anyone finds a simpler repro or a workaround like forcing `--kv-page-size=131072`, drop it here. :eyes:
